records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2025, approximately 80% of our revenue was derived from consumable products and activity-based equipment, while the balance was primarily derived from capital products with a small amount from rental and other services.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Average oil prices were lower in the first quarter 2025 compared to the first quarter 2024, while average natural gas prices nearly doubled.

records.text: We are continuing to develop products to help oil and gas operators lower expenses, increase production, and reduce their emissions while also deploying our technologies in renewable energy applications.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Segment operating income for the three months ended March 31, 2025 was $9.0 million, a $0.1 million decrease, compared to $9.1 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024.
